result.title: VibeTraining-Bench: Data-Trainer-Harness Co-Design for Iterative System Improvement
result.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires agents to diagnose system bottlenecks and coordinate improvements across training and inference. We refer to the agents' capability to jointly optimize training data, the trainer, and the inference harness as cross-component co-design. We introduce VibeTraining-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating this capability across tasks spanning terminal operation, software engineering, multi-turn tool use, and mathematical reasoning. Within each task, research agents start from an identical initial agent system under a fixed resource budget. Guided by validation feedback, they iteratively refine data, trainers, and inference harnesses, then select and submit a final agent system for evaluation on the test set. To prevent reward hacking, we enforce three safeguards: test data isolation, separate research and grading containers, and network restrictions for research agents. Our evaluation results show that frontier research agents substantially improve target agent systems. For example, on SWE-bench Verified, GPT-6-Astra raises the target agent system's performance from 32.9% to 53.7%, comparable to the human-developed instruct model's 55.4%. However, there is still room to improve their ability to co-design and iteratively refine data, trainer, and harness to achieve cumulative performance gains. We hope that VibeTraining-Bench will serve as a unified platform for advancing RSI, deepening our understanding of cross-component optimization for agent systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/D2I-ai/VibeTrainingBench.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 VibeTraining-Bench 基准，考察研究型智能体能否在固定资源预算下诊断系统瓶颈，并迭代协同优化训练数据、训练器与推理 harness，任务覆盖终端操作、软件工程、多轮工具使用与数学推理，另设测试隔离等防 reward hacking 措施。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「验证反馈驱动的迭代改进＋训练/推理框架共同配置」评测范式，可能为 LVR 的轨迹监督分配、推理 harness 设计与收益评估提供借鉴，但材料未涉及视觉状态或 latent 推理，需核查迁移价值。
